Exercise: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_extension_with_knee
- hip_flexion
- hip

Primary Muscles:

- traps

Secondary Muscles:

- adductors
- glutes
- hamstrings
- quadriceps
- shoulders

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:

- Recent or chronic lower back issues
- Shoulder instability or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- name: Barbell Sumo High Pull, equipment: barbell
- name: Dumbbell Sumo High Pull, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Place a kettlebell on the ground between your feet. Position your feet in a wide stance, and grasp the kettlebell with two hands. Set your hips back as far as possible, with your knees bent. Keep your chest and head up. This will be your starting position.
- Begin by extending the hips and knees, simultaneously pulling the kettlebell to your shoulders, raising your elbows as you do so. Reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
